hypothesis: If relevant demonstrations account for part of fewshot_all's 63.3% aggregate accuracy, retrieving up to five label-diverse neighbors will exceed 63.3% macro accuracy while using less than its 4,331-character average context.

If labeled examples contain reusable class vocabulary, compact per-label contrastive cue profiles will exceed no_memory's 33.3% aggregate accuracy while using less average context than fewshot_all's 4,331 characters.

If model errors recur on similar inputs, retrieving prior mistakes with corrected labels will exceed no_memory's 33.3% aggregate accuracy while using less average context than fewshot_all's 4,331 characters.
